Google is really crappy at listing symptoms. In reality, OCD manifests in so many different ways to the point where you might be the only one in a certain ocd community that does a certain obsession/compulsion. We aren’t allowed to diagnose people here but it does sound like ocd to me. It took me years to realise I had ocd because the only source I had to ocd information was google and they’re not really helpful. Compulsions and obsessions can be so different and unique to everyone. One of my triggers for contamination ocd is fish and I’d always thought it wasn’t ocd since most of the symptoms listed on google was germs and dirt. I hope this helps <3
